caption: The drawing consists of two black line renderings of a chair on an off-white or beige sheet, shown from the front and side views. Each view is annotated with various measurements in inches, marked with dashed dimension lines extending horizontally and vertically. The chair has a rectangular backrest, rolled arms with carved spiral ends, a cushioned seat, and turned front legs, while the back legs curve slightly backward. The side view includes a depiction of the cylindrical armrest cushion and the inclined backrest. There is an ornate carved detail at the top center of the backrest, indicated in both views, with dimensional notes beside it. The bottom right corner of the drawing features the name "H.A. Marsh" written in block letters. The entire composition is composed of precise and technical straight and curved lines, with no shading or color fill, on a plain background.
title: Chair
